subject.title: [Bug]: codexPlugins activation stalls every embedded-Codex turn — plugin/list timed out / LOCAL_REQUEST_CANCELLED; curated marketplace + plugin/install contract drift vs Codex 0.143+

question: Is the Codex 0.144.x generated schema and live app-server behavior sufficient to authorize capability-based curated activation, including continuing the base turn when configured plugin activation fails?
rationale: The failure is credible, but the exact repair crosses a versioned dependency contract and the current docs explicitly reject remote plugin installation, so an area owner must confirm the intended supported boundary before code is promoted.

options.title: Verify and repair capability-based activation
options.body: Inspect the Codex 0.144.x generated protocol and live behavior, then implement selector negotiation while keeping app exposure fail-closed and the base turn available.

options.title: Preserve fatal configured-plugin semantics
options.body: Keep explicit plugin activation turn-fatal, but replace the two-minute timeout with an immediate actionable compatibility error and updated configuration guidance.

options.title: Disable curated activation on newer Codex
options.body: Gate unsupported Codex versions and direct operators to connected-account plugins until a stable remote installation contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Verify and repair capability-based activation
recommendation.body: Inspect the Codex 0.144.x generated protocol and live behavior, then implement selector negotiation while keeping app exposure fail-closed and the base turn available.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the affected native plugin activation, inventory, and marketplace boundaries.
